({#eti, iyAya, agAt, etum, ita#})
.²1 To go, go to or towards, come to or near; {#SaSinaM punareti SarvarI#}
 <ls>R. 8. 56</ls>; {#IyurBaradvAjamunerniketam#} <ls>Bk. 3. 40</ls>.
.²2 To arrive at, reach, obtain, attain to, go to or be reduced to a particular
 state, fall into; {#nirbudDiH kzayameti#} <ls>Mk. 1. 14</ls> goes to (ruin, is
 ruined; so {#vaSam, Satrutvam, SUdratAm#} <ab>&c.</ab>).
.²3 To return.
.²4 To go away, retire; elapse, pass.
.²5 To spring from, come or arise from.
.²6 To undertake anything (with <ab>acc.</ab>); {#satramAyan#} <ls>Vāj.</ls>
.²7 To ask, beg.
.²8 To be; to appear.
.²9 To be employed in, go on with, be in a particular condition or relation,
 with a <ab>part.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab>; {#kfzanto ha sma vE vapanto yanti#} <ls>Śat. Br.</ls>;
 {#gavAmayaneneyuH#} <ls>Kāty.</ls>

.²1 To come, appear.
.²2 To run, wander.
.²3 To go quickly or repeatedly.
.²4 To ask, request.
